description: This Java class defines a command for retrieving the definition of a feature in an IoT or digital twin context. It is part of a package related to signals and commands for 'things', indicating it is used for interacting with device features via commands that can be serialized/deserialized to/from JSON.

classes.name: RetrieveFeatureDefinition
classes.description: Immutable command class that encapsulates the logic for retrieving a feature's definition, including serialization/deserialization, equality, and string representation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of RetrieveFeatureDefinition given a ThingId, featureId, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing the command targets.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID associated with this command.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer path to the feature's definition resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the command's payload data to a JSON object builder based on schema version.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.
